# Read the file
$fullContent = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText('assets\stats.txt')

# Split by newline - critical: this preserves the exact structure
$lines = $fullContent -split "`n"

Write-Host "=== VALIDATION REPORT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""

# (a) Check line count (before split, we have lines + final newline)
Write-Host "[1] Line count check:"
$contentLines = if ($fullContent.EndsWith("`n")) {
    $fullContent.Substring(0, $fullContent.Length - 1) -split "`n"
} else {
    $fullContent -split "`n"
}
$lineCount = $contentLines.Count
Write-Host "  Expected: 12 lines"
Write-Host "  Actual: $lineCount lines"
Write-Host "  Status: $(if ($lineCount -eq 12) { '✓ PASS' } else { '✗ FAIL' })"
Write-Host ""

# (b) Check line lengths
Write-Host "[2] Line length check (20-48 chars inclusive):"
$lengthPass = $true
for ($i = 0; $i -lt $contentLines.Count; $i++) {
    $len = $contentLines[$i].Length
    $pass = ($len -ge 20 -and $len -le 48)
    $status = if ($pass) { "✓" } else { "✗" }
    Write-Host "  Line $($i+1): $len chars $status"
    if (-not $pass) { $lengthPass = $false }
}
Write-Host "  Status: $(if ($lengthPass) { '✓ PASS' } else { '✗ FAIL' })"
Write-Host ""

# (c) Check allowed characters only
Write-Host "[3] Allowed characters check (A-Z 0-9 +|/\\_*.#():=- and space only):"
$allowedPattern = '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\\_\*.#():=\-]*$'
$charPass = $true
foreach ($line in $contentLines) {
    $matches = [regex]::IsMatch($line, $allowedPattern)
    if (-not $matches) {
        Write-Host "  ✗ FAIL: Line contains disallowed chars: '$line'"
        $charPass = $false
    }
}
if ($charPass) {
    Write-Host "  All lines contain only allowed characters"
    Write-Host "  Status: ✓ PASS"
}
Write-Host ""

# (d) Check for STATS substring
Write-Host "[4] STATS substring check:"
$hasStats = $fullContent -match 'STATS'
Write-Host "  Expected: Contains 'STATS'"
Write-Host "  Status: $(if ($hasStats) { '✓ PASS' } else { '✗ FAIL' })"
Write-Host ""

# (e) Check for trailing whitespace on lines
Write-Host "[5] Trailing whitespace check:"
$trailingPass = $true
foreach ($line in $contentLines) {
    if ($line -match ' $') {
        Write-Host "  ✗ FAIL: Line has trailing whitespace: '$line'"
        $trailingPass = $false
    }
}
if ($trailingPass) {
    Write-Host "  No lines have trailing whitespace"
    Write-Host "  Status: ✓ PASS"
}
Write-Host ""

# (f) Check file ending
Write-Host "[6] File ending check (exactly one trailing newline):"
$endsWithSingleNewline = $fullContent.EndsWith("`n") -and (-not $fullContent.EndsWith("`n`n"))
Write-Host "  Expected: Ends with exactly one LF"
Write-Host "  Status: $(if ($endsWithSingleNewline) { '✓ PASS' } else { '✗ FAIL' })"
Write-Host ""

# (g) ASCII only
Write-Host "[7] ASCII only check:"
$asciiPass = $true
foreach ($char in $fullContent.ToCharArray()) {
    if ([int][char]$char -gt 127) {
        Write-Host "  ✗ FAIL: Non-ASCII character found"
        $asciiPass = $false
        break
    }
}
if ($asciiPass) {
    Write-Host "  All characters are ASCII"
    Write-Host "  Status: ✓ PASS"
}
Write-Host ""

Write-Host "=== FILE CONTENT ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host ""
$contentLines | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "$_" }
Write-Host ""
Write-Host "=== SUMMARY ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "File: $(Resolve-Path 'assets\stats.txt').Path"
Write-Host ""
